scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-01 one LLM call per responsibility

steps.text: slots are filled for all responsibilities
the number of LLM calls equals 2
each call is labeled with stage stage_3

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-02 system prompt defines four ICA types

steps.text: slots are filled for all responsibilities
the system prompt contains text for ICA type NOT_PROVIDED
the system prompt contains text for ICA type INCORRECT
the system prompt contains text for ICA type WRONG_TIMING
the system prompt contains text for ICA type WRONG_DURATION

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-03 user prompt includes control structure and technology context and slots

steps.text: slots are filled for all responsibilities
the user prompt contains the control structure
the user prompt contains hazards and security constraints
the user prompt contains the technology context block
the user prompt contains the responsibility slot IDs

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-04 filled non-N/A slot has concrete ICA text

steps.text: an LLM that returns a slot with is_na false and ICA text describing a concrete failure
slots are filled for all responsibilities
at least one slot has is_na false
that slot has at least one ICA with non-empty ica_text

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-05 filled N/A slot has na_justification

steps.text: an LLM that returns a slot with is_na true and na_justification referencing a structural property
slots are filled for all responsibilities
at least one slot has is_na true
that slot has a non-empty na_justification
that slot has an empty icas list

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-06 ICAs reference valid hazard IDs from the loss analysis

steps.text: an LLM that returns ICAs referencing hazard H-1
slots are filled for all responsibilities
the ICA enumeration validates against the loss analysis and control structure

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-07 ICAs referencing invalid hazard IDs are rejected

steps.text: an LLM that returns ICAs referencing hazard H-99
slots are filled for all responsibilities
validation fails with error containing related_hazards

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-08 calls are stateless with no conversation history

steps.text: slots are filled for all responsibilities
each LLM call receives the full control structure
no call receives conversation history from a prior call

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-09 slot-filling calls are parallelizable across responsibilities

steps.text: a max_workers value of 2
slots are filled for all responsibilities in parallel
results are returned in the same order as the input responsibilities
the number of LLM calls equals 2

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-10 coordination link slots are filled separately from responsibility slots

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid slot fill results for coordination links
slots are filled for all responsibilities and coordination links
coordination link slots have responsibility null
coordination link slots are filled with ICAs or N/A justifications

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-11 all LLM calls are logged to calls.jsonl

steps.text: a run directory for output
slots are filled for all responsibilities
a file calls.jsonl exists in the run directory
the file contains entries with stage stage_3

scenarios.name: SP2-FILL-12 ICA loss_scenario is present for non-N/A slots

steps.text: an LLM that returns a slot with is_na false and one ICA with a loss scenario
slots are filled for all responsibilities
at least one ICA has a non-empty loss_scenario

background.text: the SP2 slot filling module is importable
a control structure with 2 responsibilities having 2 control actions each and 1 coordination link
a loss analysis with hazard H-1 and constraint SC-1
a technology context block with input zone failure modes
an LLM that returns valid slot fill results for each responsibility
